pages.title: A Clue Off the Map
pages.text: Animals and instruments reveal otherwise hidden finds.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Hold a buried treasure map offhand and toss a Lobster Tail; the seagull perches above treasure. Strange Fish Finder leads to a rare aquifer chunk; bucket its fish and supply submerged moss for breeding.
